name: Budgeting Assistant (Imperfect Syntax)
description: Understands core principles and references, occasionally imperfect on advanced features

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is the difference between a workbook and sheets?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The workbook is the file on my computer. Inside, I have multiple worksheet tabs, one for each department like Marketing and Operations. I can click a sheet tab to jump between them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you total each department budget?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use =SUM(C2:C15) to sum expenses. If I want the maximum expense, I write =MAX(C2:C15), and for lowest, =MIN(C2:C15). All formulas must start with =.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Explain absolute references and percent formatting.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: If company growth rate is in cell A1, I write =B2*$A$1 so when I copy it, $A$1 stays fixed as an absolute reference. To show 0.05 as 5%, I select the cell and click percent format.
